doc.title: Kent Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 22, 2006

title: Listening to his Well You Needn't recording
summary: Rowe plays Jordan's version of Monk's tune and asks about the quick half-step changes.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment
